portal.vendor_source: PlanIt scraper_type 'Fastweb' and the /FastWebPL/*.asp paths; the register host reset every connection, so its markup was not fingerprinted. The document host was fingerprinted as NEC Public Access by its RunThirdPartySearch page and embedded 'var model' rows.

document_host.note: NEC 'Public Access' document store (a naming collision: not Idox Public Access). The same shape as the Runnymede documents module under Recipe D2: the document rows are embedded in the page as 'var model ={... Rows:[{Guid, Doc_Type, Doc_Ref2, Date_Received}]}', and each file is GET Document/ViewDocument?id=<Guid>. Keyed by the human reference; no search step needed.

committee_papers.note: Committee id confirmed by the Modern.gov web service (GetCommittees) on 2026-09-26. No committee document downloaded.

reference_format.note: A bare six-digit number: two-digit year followed by a four-digit serial.

quirks.summary: On 2026-09-26 the FastWeb register host (planning.wokingham.gov.uk) reset the connection on every request, for both the search page and a detail page.
quirks.detail: The TCP connection was accepted and then closed before any HTTP response. PlanIt had scraped the same host within the previous week, so the register was live; the cause is not known and no conclusion about bot protection is drawn.
quirks.workaround: With a reference in hand, go straight to the document host. For a search by address, use the register in a browser.

quirks.summary: Date_Received in the document rows is US-ordered (MM/DD/YYYY hh:mm:ss), e.g. 09/22/2026.

pacing.note: Two failed requests to the register and three requests to the document host at 5 s spacing on 2026-09-26; no 429 or challenge on the document host.

robots.note: No robots.txt on the document host (404). The register host could not be reached to check.

browser_route.note: The register's detail page. The documents list is https://publicaccess.wokingham.gov.uk/PublicAccess_LIVE/SearchResult/RunThirdPartySearch?FileSystemid=PL&FOLDER1_REF=<REF>.

verification.note: PlanIt's areas record gave the FastWeb register; its applics records gave the document-host link. The register reset the connection on two requests (search page and fulldetail.asp). Document host for 262222: RunThirdPartySearch page with 12 document rows (PlanIt n_documents 12) -> ViewDocument?id=<Guid> -> application/pdf, %PDF-1.7 magic bytes. Modern.gov GetCommittees checked for the committee id. Content check on a full download: 810,437 bytes, 1 page with extractable text, no rate-limit, permission or unavailable notice.
